title: Vallee hints Bob Lazar was an MK Ultra subject

tellings.quote: when he hints that Bob Lazar was actually an MK Ultra patient possibly the subject of government brainwashing which led him to believe he worked on reverse engineering UFOs

related.note: Both are about Bob Lazar's claim to have reverse-engineered UFOs at S4 in Nevada in the late 1980s. This telling, drawn from Vallee's book Revelations, explains that claim as the product of MK Ultra-style government brainwashing, not real work on alien craft, so the two accounts cannot both be right.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on reverse engineering alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, may actually have been a subject of MK Ultra, a CIA mind control program, and brainwashed into believing his story. Michels says this is what the computer scientist and UFO researcher Jacques Vallée hints at in his book Revelations: Alien Contact and Human Deception. If so, Lazar's account would be a product of government manipulation rather than real work on UFOs.
